assignmentNote: RACI assignment is proposed from the reusable team template. Adjust once if ownership changed.
principles: Legal, compliance, and customer-contract requirements take precedence over product or sourcing preferences.
Security and data-access boundaries take precedence over convenience.
Standard platform patterns take precedence over custom one-off solutions.
defaultRule: Whoever proposes deviating from the org standard carries the burden of proof; if unresolved by deadline, the reasoned proposal or standard applies.
constraints: An AI coding agent implements the approved plan.md — ambiguities become assumptions unless closed first.
Platform team receives no product requirement questions (consulted only when build, queue, or deployment infra changes).

parties.name: Business
parties.job: Decides customer-visible behavior, compliance/PII rules, and supplies domain facts.
parties.consultWhen: Customer-visible behavior, personal data (PII), or regulatory/contractual rules are affected.

parties.name: Product Owner
parties.job: Decides UX trade-offs, defaults, and acceptance criteria where proposals exist.

parties.name: Architect
parties.job: Decides execution architecture, API contracts, and performance bounds.

parties.name: Platform Team
parties.job: Answers no product questions; consulted only if background workers, queues, or deployment config change.
parties.consultWhen: Background workers, queues, CI/CD pipelines, or deployment config change.
